reviews.text: Please retrain the part-timer who wears glasses and has short hair. When I asked for a small coffee, they immediately paid 1,500 won. When I went to the machine to choose a size, there were M and L. Of course, I asked for the small one, so I pressed M and waited. When I looked at the price tag, I saw that M size was 1,300 won. I went back to the part-timer and asked him, and he told me that our store only had 1,500 items on the computer. Then, shouldn't we have told them from the beginning when checking out that our store only has large sizes? When I asked about this, they didn't show any apologies and kept repeating like a parrot that there was only one store in our store. No, they should have told the customer when paying. So, people who ordered size M up to now paid 1,500 won without receiving any explanation? I don't know what's wrong with the employee's attitude and I will report this to the head office. I'm so absurd and angry after hearing that the part-timer said he would refund the money without any attitude that he was really doing anything wrong.

editorial_summary: This is an Apple retail store that sells iPhones, iPads, etc. in a space with a stylish interior.

reviews.author: Eliza Baibatchaeva
reviews.text:
I had a very unpleasant experience at the store today.
I came here considering purchasing the iPhone 17 Pro Max, and actually purchased the Apple Watch.
Even though I could communicate in Korean, the staff's attitude was very rude and I didn't feel welcome at all.
We weren't even allowed to see or touch the product, and we weren't even shown the eyeglasses at all. Even when I asked questions, they responded in an insincere manner or treated me as if I were a disturbing guest.
This kind of service is difficult to understand for customers who come to purchase expensive products. The entire purchasing experience was ruined by the service, not the product itself.
It was nowhere near the level of customer service I expected from a brand like Apple, and I was very disappointed.
I believe that service training and attitude improvement are absolutely necessary.

reviews.author: HS IM
reviews.text:
The male staff member in the watch section had the worst response.
He went to get the product to help us try it on, but on the way, he went to two other female customers and explained things to them, leaving us standing for a while.
He came back a while later and brought only the body without the strap I requested, and even brought a 45mm instead of the 42mm I requested.
I was very displeased because they did not follow basic customer service procedures and lacked professionalism.
Please train your employees properly!!!

reviews.author: Chattutsu
reviews.text: I expected it to be an Apple Store, but even within one store, I could clearly feel the difference in service from each employee. When I inquired about diagnosing a product defect, the male employee seemed to have a marked lack of understanding and expertise about the defect, and when answering, I was embarrassed because he only said in an emotional tone, “I can’t accept it without a reservation.” On the other hand, the female employees had high professionalism, excellent understanding of defects, and most of all, responded kindly. The male staff member immediately processed the diagnosis, which he said was impossible without a reservation, after registering on the waiting list, so the work was done clearly and quickly. There was such a difference in service even within the same store, and the difference in experience was clearly felt.

Aside from employee training, didn't they receive home training?
I'm on my way to another branch.

reviews.text:

If I lived in Konkuk University, I would come here every day, every month, every year. What an amazing meal full of dietary fiber, vitamins, carbohydrates, and protein. It's 250,000 times better than a greasy and nutritious restaurant. It's like a gem in the sand.

I really enjoyed it and was very impressed.

reviews.author: Mong
reviews.text:
It is written as ‘baekban’ and read as ‘cos’.
It starts with colorful fruit salad, pancakes, and sprout vegetable pancakes, followed by dessert.
Even excluding the soup and rice, there are 8 side dishes... Honestly, the amount is so Hongik Ingan that I wonder if it's right to do business with leftovers. (If you usually eat small meals, you may have to skip a meal before going.)
The quality of the side dishes is consistent, so I visited 4 times at intervals, and all 4 times, the side dishes were fresh and not too salty, without any harsh seasoning or seasoning, and were just delicious. After eating the side dishes, I decided to leave the main meal.
But does that mean the main story is not that good? No. Just try this for yourself. There are a lot of menus and each one definitely has its own kick.
Because the portion size is too large, I tend to give up one of the appetizers (usually pancakes). The wisest thing to do is to hold back on pancakes for a while and then adjust the amount based on the rice.
If you don't like a lot of packaging being recycled, it's better to be patient. They are kind and take care of almost all courses. Dessert is pumpkin sikhye.
I understand if you raise the price by 3,000 won for humane reasons. Even the ridiculously bad menu items around here cost 10,000 won... I'm really lucky that I found it early.

reviews.author: Hong Chu-min
reviews.text:
For something that appeared in the media, it wasn't very good.

1. Location: Ambiguous. I walked to Konkuk University, and I walked more than I expected. 10 minutes?? 15 minutes?? I think it's about that much, but I think it would be better to go to Children's Grand Park.

2.Space: 7 tables? There is only so much. It's narrow. It's okay if you go with less than 4 people, but if you go with more than that, you may have to wait. It’s a small space, like a local meat restaurant.

3. Taste: The meat called chimatsal is almost close to the taste of jeongjeongsal. First of all, it is more convenient than you think to prepare it and eat it. The meat is chewy and delicious. And as you can see in the picture, I mixed the pickled green onions with soy sauce and it was really delicious. But I definitely felt that the price of meat was quite high. It was okay up to this point, but after that, what about a mouth-watering meal?? I really didn't like this. people
The reviews were good, but the anchovy broth smelled really fishy to me. I've tried many soybean paste stews based on anchovy broth, but this is the first time I've tried something this fishy. The taste was so shocking that I forgot the taste of the meat. ㅠㅠ

4. Next time, if I go there, I think I will leave in a good mood as long as I don't eat a lot of food.
